Türkiye
Consular help:Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Ankara or by the Consulate General of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Istanbul, Türkiye.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Republic of Türkiye are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
Travel Tips: Starting from 01.01.2015. year, BH citizens will when traveling to the Republic of Türkiye have to possess a travel document with a validity of at least 60 days from the expiry date: the intended stay, visas or residence permits.For all additional clarifications and instructions, citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina can contact the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Ankara and the Consulate General of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Istanbul.
Drugs: severe prison sentences.
Sanitary Conditions: good.
Dialing Code: 90
